name: halkliff-orchestration
description: Explicit orchestration with pinned instructions, session activation, and bounded local helpers.

interface.longDescription: Run the existing orchestrate-work workflow with bundled instructions and explicitly activated local helpers for dispatch checks, recovery, observed counters, and retirement preflight.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $orchestrate-work-plugin for this outcome with my selected orchestrator. Create and coordinate GPT-6.1 Sol task threads as needed for substantial parallel work; use subagents alone for light work. Allow main-thread workers and Sol task threads to exchange findings and clarifications directly, keeping decisions and uncertainty with their parents. Confirm goal-backed execution (recommended, using $define-goal) or goal-free execution, and my understood outcome and verification process before activation or implementation. Follow the workflow setup and acceptance rules.
